title: Enable newsletters on Shipped end to end
description: Shipped-web: pin bump, newsletter plugin config, signup component on the roundup page, roundup archive at /roundup/. Verify with a test inbox Ryan controls. Tracks ship-7e99a6.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Shipped is live with the newsletter plugin (AnthusAI/Shipped-web PR #30, Amplify job 29 SUCCEED; plugin stack created: table, KMS key, key parameter, functions papyrus-newsletter-shipped and papyrus-newsletter-send-shipped, send queue plus DLQ, weekly draft schedule, two alarms, SNS subscriptions). Verified with the SES mailbox simulator, no real address mailed: form on /roundup/ (screenshots 1280 and 390), subscribe 202, honeypot stores nothing, invalid email/list 400, confirm 303 with confirmedAt/IP/UA, preferences 200, one-click unsubscribe 200, re-subscribe, bounce and complaint suppressed via SNS (SUPP rows, EVENTS rows), alarms OK, configuration set still sending; simulator subscribers erased. Finding for core: /api/* inherits the edge's distribution-level custom error responses (403 and 404 -> /404.html with 404), so the route's 403 origin_mismatch reaches a browser as the site 404 page (the origin does return 403 JSON); harmless for security, worth knowing for debugging. Waiting for the human test (Ryan subscribes with his own inbox, confirms, receives a test issue, one-click unsubscribe). Left open.
